expo.name: Rider Comms

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Rider Comms uses your microphone for hands-free group voice chat while riding.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rider Comms uses your location to find riders in your zone and give turn-by-turn directions.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Rider Comms uses your location in the background so your zone stays accurate while riding with the screen off.

expo._NOTE: Background audio + location together are flagged in the spec (Section 10) as the single biggest engineering risk on iOS specifically — this config declares the right entitlements, but actually surviving background execution needs real device testing this sandbox can't do.
